title: Bearings and the cosine rule
problem: From a lighthouse $L$, boat $A$ is 18 km away on a bearing of 045° and boat $B$ is 22 km away on a bearing of 105°. Find the distance between the two boats.

steps.instruction: Find the angle at the lighthouse between $LA$ and $LB$.
Apply the cosine rule in triangle $ALB$, with $LA = 18$ km, $LB = 22$ km and included angle $60°$.
Take the square root to find $AB$.

answer: The distance between the two boats is approximately 20.30 km.

title: Radial survey — area of a section
problem: In a radial survey from central point $O$, two boundary posts are recorded: $OA = 50$ m on a bearing of 030° and $OB = 40$ m on a bearing of 095°. Find the area of triangle $OAB$.

steps.instruction: Find the angle at $O$ between the two directions.
Apply the triangle area formula with the two known sides and included angle.

answer: The area of triangle $OAB$ is approximately 906 m².

title: Two-leg journey — finding the interior angle
problem: A drone flies 25 km from base $P$ on a bearing of 055° to point $A$. It then flies 30 km on a bearing of 135° to point $B$. Find the straight-line distance from $P$ to $B$.

steps.instruction: Find the interior angle of the triangle at $A$. The drone flew to $A$ on bearing 055°, so find the backward direction (from $A$ toward $P$).
Find the interior angle at $A$ between the backward direction and the forward direction to $B$ (bearing 135°).
Apply the cosine rule in triangle $PAB$ with $PA = 25$ km, $AB = 30$ km and $\angle PAB = 100°$.
Take the square root to find $PB$.

answer: The straight-line distance from $P$ to $B$ is approximately 42.25 km.
